title: Australian Wrap
description: A tasty wrap filled with crunchy veggies and Australian spices, perfect for a quick snack or light meal.
instructions: Lay the Australian wrap flat on a clean surface.
Spread the daring sauce evenly over the center of the wrap.
Add the crunchy coleslaw on top of the sauce.
Sprinkle the sliced almonds and shredded lettuce over the coleslaw.
Fold the two sides of the wrap towards the center, then roll it up tightly.
Slice in half and serve immediately.
